remarks: This stunning shingle and stone Colonial perfectly blends traditional architecture with modern luxury amenities, offering a resort-at-home lifestyle while maintaining close-to-town convenience.  The heart of the home is a brand-new Deane kitchen, featuring an oversized center island, high-end side-by-side refrigerator/freezer, two sinks, two dishwashers, and a premium range. This space is complemented by a dedicated bar area equipped with a large wine fridge and additional refrigerator drawers. The main level also boasts a magnificent great room with vaulted ceilings, along with a formal dining room, living room, and a separate family room, providing the open floor plan that today's buyers prioritize.  Situated on two peaceful acres near the New Canaan village center and Metro-North, the property also offers exceptional outdoor living. You will find a bluestone terrace with a full outdoor kitchen and a heated saltwater pool with a cascading waterfall spa.  With three finished, move-in-ready levels, this property is a rare find.
